footer.description: A vertically integrated holding company spanning real estate, global commerce, and executive education. Building legacies and transforming industries.

about.storyDesc1: Driven Group was founded in 2022 by our CEO Iván Rodríguez with the vision of building a global company from Guadalajara Jalisco, a strategic point within a dynamic economy.
about.storyDesc2: From its origins in the real estate sector, with a focus on short-term rentals and construction, the company evolved in Europe and North America, particularly in the commercial sector, brand creation, and business development.
about.storyDesc3: As part of its consolidation process, in 2026 Ricardo Hernández joins as a strategic partner, strengthening and accelerating the consolidation and expansion of the group.
about.storyDesc4: That same year, Driven Group formally structures its business model into three strategic divisions: Business, Real Estate, and Academy.
about.storyDesc5: Integrating a unit dedicated to training and knowledge transfer, consolidating a business ecosystem spanning from business creation to real estate investment, with a focus on innovation, sustainability, and shared value that articulates business, real estate, and education.
